items.fluidlogistics:compressed_storage_tank.t: Right-click a Fluid Tank to _transfer fluid_ and _consume_ the Compressed Storage Tank.
items.fluidlogistics:empty_fluid_schematic.too: Used for writing at the _Schematic Table_.
items.fluidlogistics:fluid_schematic.tooltip.b: Can be positioned using the Tools on Screen.
items.fluidlogistics:fluid_schematic.tooltip.s: Holds a fluid structure to be positioned and placed into the world. Position the Hologram as desired and use a _Copper-Cased Schematicannon_ to build it.
items.fluidlogistics:frost_cake.tooltip.summar: A Delicious treat for your hard-working _Blaze Coolers_. Gets them all cooled down!
items.fluidlogistics:hand_pointer.tooltip.beha: Packagers / Re-Packagers / Package Frogports / Postboxes / Mechanical Arms / Mechanical Crafters / Mechanical Fluid Guns / Threshold Switches / Weighted Ejectors / Display Links / Logistics Network Components / Any Filter
items.fluidlogistics:hand_pointer.tooltip.summ: Multi-purpose tool for configuring _interaction points_ on mechanical components
items.fluidlogistics:phantom_chain.tooltip.sum: When _connecting_ Chain Conveyors, their _chains_ are only visible while _holding_ a _Phantom Chain_

blocks.fluidlogistics:copper_schematicannon.too: Shoots fluids to recreate a deployed _Fluid Schematic_ in the World. Uses fluids from adjacent Fluid Containers and _Gunpowder_ as fuel.
blocks.fluidlogistics:fluid_hatch.tooltip.behav: _Deposits_ _contained fluid_ from your _held item_ into the _tank_ it is placed on. If the held item cannot be emptied, it _fills_ the item from the _tank_ instead.
_Fills_ your _held fluid container_ from the _tank_ first. If it cannot be filled, contained fluid is _deposited_ into the _tank_ instead.
blocks.fluidlogistics:fluid_hatch.tooltip.summa: _Quickly adapts_ your _tank_ for use with _fluid containers_.
blocks.fluidlogistics:infinite_fluid_tank.toolt: Stores _%s_ of one fluid to provide an infinite supply.
